title: LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything
title_zh: LensErase：一种可擦除任意内容的基模

paragraphs.en: LensErase 是一种可处理多样擦除场景的基模。 We introduce LensErase, a general-purpose mask-based Erase Anything foundation model designed to cover a broad spectrum of real-world erase scenarios. LensErase supports diverse objects, visual text, watermarks, associated visual effects, multiple-object removal, and a wide range of object scales, aspect ratios, and image resolutions. First, to enable such broad coverage, we construct LensErase-100M, a large-scale dataset containing 101.07 million paired source-mask-target examples spanning diverse erase scenarios. Second, we pretrain LensErase from the text-to-image model Lens, adapting its strong generative prior to mask-based erasing. To efficiently incorporate the source image and erase mask, we propose Mask-Aware RoPE, a 3D rotary positional encoding that directly injects mask information into the source-image tokens without introducing a separate mask token sequence. Finally, we refine the model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with contract-guided, region-aware rewards, and apply TraceFusion at inference to preserve high-fidelity content outside the effective edit region. Across six public benchmarks and the proposed LensErase-Bench, LensErase achieves substantial improvements under both reference-based objective metrics and reference-free VLM evaluation. We hope LensErase can serve as a foundational model for erase-related applications and systems.
paragraphs.zh: LensErase 是一种能够处理多样化擦除场景的基础模型。我们提出了 LensErase，这是一种基于掩码的通用“擦除任意内容”基础模型，旨在覆盖广泛多样的现实世界擦除场景。 LensErase 支持多种对象、视觉文本、水印、相关的视觉效果、多对象移除，以及广泛的对象尺度、宽高比和图像分辨率。 首先，为了实现如此广泛的覆盖能力，我们构建了 LensErase-100M——一个大规模数据集，包含 10107 万个成对的源图-掩码-目标示例，涵盖了多样化的擦除场景。 其次，我们从文本到图像模型 Lens 出发对 LensErase 进行预训练，将其强大的生成先验知识适配到基于掩码的擦除任务中。 为了高效地整合源图像和擦除掩码，我们提出了 Mask-Aware RoPE——一种三维旋转位置编码方法，它无需引入独立的掩码令牌序列，即可将掩码信息直接注入到源图像的令牌中。 最后，我们通过监督微调以及结合合同引导的区域感知奖励的强化学习来优化模型，并在推理阶段应用 TraceFusion，以保留有效编辑区域之外的高保真内容。 在六个公开基准数据集以及我们提出的 LensErase-Bench 上，LensErase 在基于参考的客观指标和无参考的 VLM 评估中均实现了显著提升。 我们希望 LensErase 能够成为擦除相关应用和系统的基础模型。
